how_to_apply: Fill the Application Form in the prescribed format furnished with the notice, duly typed (not hand-written).
Attach soft copies of self-attested copies of each supporting document, certificate and reprint.
If you are presently engaged in any project at CSIR-CGCRI or any other organisation, lab or institute, attach a copy of the NOC from your existing Project Leader.
Attach a self-attested soft copy of your University/Institute rule for calculating percentage from CGPA/DGPA, where it applies.
Email the soft copy of the application to [email protected] so that it is received by 26 November 2026. No application will be entertained after this date.
Submit a separate application if you apply for more than one position or advertisement number.
An incomplete application without the prescribed format and supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CGCRI Research Associate - I (RA - I) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention an application fee.

rows.details: CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute (Council of Scientific & Industrial Research)
GAP-0391: "Development of a ceramic membrane integrated fermentative reactor process for production and enrichment of biohydration from organic waste"

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PhD in Science / Engineering Or, M.E./ M.Tech in Chemical Engineering/ Chemical Technology/ Bio Technology with 3 years research experience and at least one SCI publication. The 3 years of research experience and the SCI publication are required with the M.E./M.Tech route; the notice lists the PhD as a separate option. Experience in modelling / Simulation. The age limit is 40 Years, counted as on the date of interview. Only bonafide Indian citizens will be engaged. Candidates with results awaited will not be eligible. Candidates must calculate the percentage from CGPA/DGPA as per the calculation rule of their University/Institute and attach a self-attested soft copy of that rule. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate - I receives a stipend of Rs. 58,000/- plus HRA; the notice does not print the HRA amount. The engagement is in project GAP-0391, and the tenure is printed as 11.03.2027. CSIR-CGCRI reserves the right not to fill up the position, and the number of positions may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-CGCRI Research Associate - I (RA - I)
content_sections.text: An incomplete application without the prescribed format and supporting documents will be summarily rejected. Typed Application Form in the prescribed format Self-attested soft copies of supporting documents, certificates and reprints NOC from the existing Project Leader (only for candidates presently engaged in a project) Self-attested soft copy of the CGPA/DGPA conversion rule At the interview: original marksheet, certificates and age-caste proof, plus self-attested copies of all documents and the project thesis (if any)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The walk-in interview for the Research Associate - I (RA - I) will be held on 30 November 2026 from 11.00 a.m. at CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute, 196, Raja S. C. Mullick Road, Kolkata-32. Candidates must report at least one hour before the scheduled time of interview for verification of documents. No candidate will be allowed to enter the Institute if arriving after the reporting time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-CGCRI Research Associate - I recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Research Associate - I (RA - I) position, Post Code 62/2627/01, in project GAP-0391 at CSIR-CGCRI, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be received by email by 26 November 2026; no application will be entertained after that date.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026 from 11.00 a.m. at CSIR-CGCRI, Kolkata, and candidates must report at least one hour before the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the CSIR-CGCRI Research Associate - I post?
faq.answer: A PhD in Science / Engineering, or an M.E./M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Chemical Technology or Bio Technology with 3 years research experience and at least one SCI publication. Experience in modelling / simulation is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 Years as on the date of interview, relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped and Female candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy layer) candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a CSIR-CGCRI Research Associate - I?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 58,000/- per the notice, with HRA paid on top of it.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the typed application form in the prescribed format, with self-attested soft copies of all supporting documents, certificates and reprints, to [email protected] by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the original marksheet, certificates and age-caste proof for verification, plus self-attested copies of all documents and the project thesis, if any.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply if my final result is awaited?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that candidates with results awaited will not be eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need an NOC if I am already working in a project?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates presently engaged in any project at CSIR-CGCRI or any other organisation, lab or institute must furnish a copy of the NOC from their existing Project Leader.
